question: What initial yogic practice begins when one engages the root wheel?
premises: The root wheel is practiced first.
The practice is addressed to the beloved.
inference: Engagement with the root wheel marks the first stage of the described practice.
uncertainties: The fused forms mūlacakrantu and yadānyabhyasate are interpretively segmented in meaning only.
plain_english: O beloved, first, when one practices with the root wheel...
